successCriteria.description: The `update` method in `PgLeavePolicyRepository` returns `null` (not throws) when the target row is deleted by a concurrent operation between the pre-check `findById` and the `UPDATE ... RETURNING *` query.

The `update` method's post-UPDATE empty-result check follows the same pattern already established in `findById` and `findByLeaveType` within the same file: `if (result.rows.length === 0) return null;` before calling `rowToLeavePolicy`.

constraints: The fix must not change the method signature — `update(id: string, data: Partial<LeavePolicy>): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>` remains unchanged.
The fix must not remove or alter the existing pre-check `findById` call — it is an additive guard after the UPDATE query only.
No new dependencies, imports, or modules may be introduced. The change is confined to the body of the `update` method in `src/modules/leave-policy/pg-leave-policy.repository.ts`.
outOfScope: No new or modified unit tests — this phase is a targeted bugfix to the `update` method body only. Test coverage for the race-condition scenario is deferred.

entityInvariants.invariant: The `update` method must never throw a TypeError caused by passing `undefined` to `rowToLeavePolicy`. If the row disappears between the pre-check and the UPDATE (concurrent delete), the method returns `null` — consistent with the `LeavePolicy | null` return type.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns `null` when the entity does not exist at the time of the UPDATE — whether it was never present or concurrently deleted. Must not throw for this case.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The post-UPDATE empty-result guard must use the identical pattern already present in `findById` and `findByLeaveType` within the same file: check `result.rows.length === 0`, return `null`, and only then call `rowToLeavePolicy(result.rows[0])`.
